summary: In Genesis 12:5 the verb describes acquiring property. The related noun denotes the possessions Abram took with him when he left Haran.

senses.definition: Property or goods that someone owns, taken collectively.

evidence.note: כָּל רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁוּ describes all the possessions the travelers had acquired and took with them.
